facts.value: Although MyPath2ASU® is not required to transfer to ASU, it can make your transfer journey simpler and cost-effective by aligning your coursework with your intended ASU major. The earlier you sign up, the better. If you’re starting at a community college, MyPath2ASU® will guide you through your course planning starting with your first term at the community college. When you’re ready to apply to ASU, you’ll be able to transfer with confidence knowing exactly how your credits will transfer to ASU and your major.
